name: 고개 끄덕임/흔들기 패턴 분석
description: Analyzes head nodding and shaking patterns for natural conversational synchronization — AI often desynchronizes.
mechanism:
This method analyzes head gesture dynamics for deepfake detection:

1. **HeadPose추적**: Head orientation (yaw, pitch, roll) is estimated per frame using facial landmark geometry or 3D head model fitting. Head pose signals are decomposed to identify gestural movements (nods = pitch oscillation, shakes = yaw oscillation).

2. **GestureKinematics분석**: Natural head gestures follow specific kinematics: (a) nodding involves 10-20° pitch oscillation at 1-2 Hz, (b) shaking involves 15-30° yaw oscillation at 1-2.5 Hz, (c) gestures show smooth sinusoidal profiles with physiologically constrained velocity. The method checks whether detected gestures fall within natural kinematic parameters.

3. **Gesture-발화상관**: Head gestures correlate with speech prosody — nods often coincide with stressed syllables, head movements accompany turn-taking in conversation. The method analyzes temporal correlation between head motion and speech intensity. Deepfakes may show gestures temporally decoupled from speech.

4. **Neck-HeadCoordination**: Head rotation involves coupled neck and cervical spine motion with characteristic ranges — large yaw rotations involve torso contribution. The method verifies head-neck-shoulder coordination. Deepfake generators that only manipulate the face may produce head rotations that don't propagate correctly to neck and shoulders.

5. **Inertial일관성**: Head motion should show proper inertial dynamics — acceleration/deceleration following the mass and muscle force constraints of the head-neck system. The method analyzes the frequency content and jerk profile of head motion. AI-generated head movements may lack natural inertial characteristics.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
